policy: Lossless native rectangles only, no resize/key/repaint. Original native singles stay1254, oldquarters627, unusualyaw canvases preserved; scale/calibration unverified. Directions follow guide roles, washerTR/BR remapped by actual attachments.

Washer yaw labels remapped by actual fixed attachments: N=TL,E=BR,S=BL,W=TR.
Bench and dispenser normals use explicit selected original quarters plus native corrected singles; native dimensions retained, no scaling.
